```{python}
# Load dataset and initial packages
import pandas as pd 
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fifa = pd.read_csv('/Users/jameschen/Downloads/FIFA20.csv')

# Remove players with 0 value
fifa = fifa[fifa["value_eur"] > 0]

# Use value in millions
fifa["value_millions"] = fifa["value_eur"] / 1_000_000

# Select the player's primary position
fifa["primary_position"] = fifa["player_positions"].str.split(",").str[0].str.strip()

def position_group(pos):
    if pos in ["ST", "CF", "LW", "RW", "LF", "RF"]:
        return "Forward"
    else:
        return "Other"
        
# Only focus on Forwards
fifa["position_group"] = fifa["primary_position"].apply(position_group)

# New dataframe        
forwards = fifa[fifa["position_group"] == "Forward"].copy()

# Create bronze, silver, gold groups based on overall rating
def forward_tier(overall):
    if overall <= 64:
        return "Bronze"
    elif 65 <= overall <= 74:
        return "Silver"
    else:
        return "Gold"

forwards["tier"] = forwards["overall"].apply(forward_tier)

# Boxplot to compare the market value of positions within the forward group for all three tiers
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
for tier in ["Bronze", "Silver", "Gold"]:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
    sns.boxplot(
        data=forwards[forwards["tier"] == tier],
        x="primary_position",
        y="value_millions",
        showfliers=False
    )
    
    plt.title(f"Forward Market Value by Position: {tier}", fontsize=14)
    plt.xlabel("Forward Position", fontsize=11)
    plt.ylabel("Market Value (€ Millions)", fontsize=11)
    plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

# Scatterplot to see age vs market value of forwards in general for all three tiers 
for tier in ["Bronze", "Silver", "Gold"]:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=forwards[forwards["tier"] == tier],
        x="age",
        y="value_millions",
        alpha=0.6
    )

    plt.title(f"Age vs. Market Value: {tier} Forwards")
    plt.xlabel("Age")
    plt.ylabel("Market Value (€ Millions)")
    plt.xticks(range(15, 41, 5))
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

```
